Will You Ever Turn On Ads

No.

Not only are ads extremely annoying, create a conflict of interest, destroy UX (user experience), use more bandwidth, and increase loading times, they can also be malicious and harmful to the end user. If ads ever appear on this site, please stop visiting.

No Ads? How Will You Monetize

There was once a wonderful time in recent history where people would create projects known as a "labor of love" projects. This was prevalent the past and can still be seen in a lot of open source software, the very software that powers these forums in fact. Unfortunately, it seems like everything is all about the money now. That's not the case with ____. I have a full time job and anyone else who helps out with this is most likely also have a full time job. In other words, the point of these forums is not to generate income but to provide a place for people to discuss video games and the video games industry without having to deal with annoying ads, mods or admins. It's a labor a love. Now, that doesn't mean I can continue to keep funding the website all by myself from here on out. Right now it's fine. Ideally, the community will grow quite large. When that happens, there will be some serious monitory needs in order to keep up with server costs and building out an infrastructure that can support a large online community. What happens at that point? Good question, the answer certainly is not intrusive ads. Most likely, I will set up a donation system. If the forums are good and people enjoy the community, there will enviably be a few members who don't mind donating a little bit to help offset the costs of running the website.

If the community grows so large that I can't personally fund the website anymore and no one wants to donate, then I will shut the website down. If no one wants to donate, let's be honest, it must not be a good community anyway.

What About...Mods?

In today's internet culture, the idea of a "mod" has become quite odd. It seems like the majority of online communities are governed by mods who care more about making personal and political statements than actually moderating a community. In the case of _____, mods will first and for most be an equal part of the community. They won't have some special avatar or colored named asserting their dominance over new users. Mods won't be ban happy people who ban users who disagree with them. Mods won't be treated like kings and queens just because they are mods.

Can Users Get Banned?

Of course they can and they will. If users post something inappropriate or do something that violates the Terms of Service, they will be banned.

Are Marketers Able to Create Accounts?

Yes, marketers and those in video game marketing can create accounts and post on the forums. We would love for them to! If they start heavily and obviously promoting their company or companies they represent, we will kindly let them know that's not allowed. If they continue they will get banned.

Can I Create An Account With A Free Email Address?

Yes. No.

All users must create an account using their school, work, or isp email address.

Why Did I Not Get A Confirmation Email When I Signed Up?

One of two reasons. The first reason is that you did not use the correct type of email address. The second reason is that each user must be manually confirmed. This process won't take long but there will be a small delay of anywhere from ten minutes to one day.
